sam-sec: Proposal: tighten dev log retention to 14d, keep prod at 365d. Export snapshots to encrypted long-term bucket for incidents only.
rachel-legal: legal needs ticketed justification + requestor/approver in metadata; audit trail kept 7y.
devops-mike: we'll enforce SSE-KMS and add IAM roles: export.request, export.approve, export.retrieve. Only security and legal groups get approve/retrieve.
amara-sre: add manifest + SHA256 HMAC for every export; validator job will reject missing manifest.
nist-jira-bot: automated rule: if jira.incident_id present and requester in security group => auto-approve.
sam-sec: also define CMK rotation guidance so old archives remain decryptable. mike to draft key policy.
rachel-legal: require `legal_hold` boolean and `case_id` optional in manifest.
sam-sec: ok, i'll write the RFC and assign action items. target: land before next billing cycle.
